- Exam 01 will take place in-person on Tuesday, September 23, during class. This exam is an opportunity to demonstrate what you've learned in the course thus far.  

- The exam will be closed-book. 

- You should bring something to write with. Nothing else is permitted (i.e. calculators, cheat sheets not permitted.)

- Content covered: Lectures 1-7, Labs 1-3, HW 1-3. 

## Types of questions

- The questions may be a mix of multiple choice, true/false, or short answer. 

- To prepare, review the definitions, concepts, and examples in the lectures. Review all lab assignments and homework assignments. 

- There will be three sections: Code, Conceptual, and Applied. Examples of each of these sections can be found in `exam-01-practice.pdf`

## Resources for reviewing

- A formula sheet (formulas you would be provided on the exam) will be posted Thursday September 11.

- A topics list will be posted on Thursday, September 11.

- I will prepare a set of review questions for us to complete in class on Thursday September 18. We will go over these together and you will have access to the solutions after class.
